source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Your **KILL TEAM** units that have this ability gain three abilities:

- **Furor Tactics**: under the **[devastator doctrine](vsdata:ability/space-marines.combat-doctrines)**, the unit's attacks get **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)**.
- **Malleus Tactics**: under the **[tactical doctrine](vsdata:ability/space-marines.combat-doctrines)**, its attacks get **[[LETHAL HITS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)**.
- **Purgatus Tactics**: under the **[assault doctrine](vsdata:ability/space-marines.combat-doctrines)**, its attacks get **[[PRECISION]](vsdata:weapon-ability/precision)** against enemy units within 9" of it.

**DEATHWATCH ALLIES**: your army may include **DEATHWATCH** units despite their different Chapter keyword, up to 500 points combined, as an exception to **Space Marine Chapters Army Rules**. Unless stated otherwise, a **DEATHWATCH** model cannot be your **WARLORD**, and **KILL TEAM** units can take Enhancements only from this detachment.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 7 of 273 combat readings of Detachment rules (every record of the class not withheld otherwise, each time) wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
